section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q), a 36-item self-report measure with four subscales (restraint, eating concern, shape concern, and weight concern). It details how the global EDE-Q score is calculated and mentions its good psychometric properties in both original and Portuguese versions. The text refers to 'the present study' when discussing the Cronbach's alpha range for the EDE-Q scores (0.77 to 0.95).
